title: application built with libebur128 1.2.5 on x64 Windows crashing with exit code 0xc0000135

labels.name: category:port-bug
labels.description: The issue is with a library, which is something the port should already support

labels.name: depends:upstream-changes
labels.description: Waiting on a change to the upstream project

body:
**Describe the bug**
I am working on [getting Mixxx building](https://github.com/mixxxdj/mixxx/pull/3615) with dependencies from vcpkg. We are building dependencies with vcpkg, creating an archive with `vcpkg export`, uploading it to our file server, then downloading that on GitHub Actions. Using [this branch](https://github.com/mixxxdj/vcpkg/tree/fdk_aac_fedora) based on 401b26c9866a071f645ae57831caa419b2c48be1, Mixxx built and ran fine. But when I tried merging those changes with the latest upstream master branch, [every test started failing](https://github.com/mixxxdj/mixxx/runs/1840131648) with exit code 0xc0000135. We are using the CMake toolchain file from the vcpkg export archive. The only thing that changed was using a different `vcpkg export` archive; nothing changed in the application code or application build system.

**Environment**
- OS: windows-x64
- Compiler: MSVC 19.28.29336.0
- We are using X_VCPKG_APPLOCAL_DEPS_INSTALL
